sources.text: The induced latent task set should reflect the actual task being performed and remain stable across different execution strategies. For each run i, TMI observes only the trajectory and produces an induced latent task set Ti. The dataset’s ground-truth assigned task yi is withheld from induction and used only for evaluation. We give Ti and yi to the LLM judge, which returns a binary label indicating whether the induced task set correctly captures the assigned task. We report the average match rate across runs. # KPMG Research Executive Brief

## Stakeholder Persona
Allison Tatterson

## Question
What was the held-out task accuracy gain from skills derived from TMI?

## Confidence Tier & Rationale
Moderate (70% evidence score)

Moderate: retrieval scores were not saved and contribute zero. Weights: retrieval 30%, citation coverage 30%, quote/numeric checks 25%, source diversity 15%. This evidence indicator does not verify meaning, answer completeness or business outcomes; human review is required.

## What the Study Found
The held-out task accuracy gain from skills derived from TMI was 30% relative, as indicated in passage [1], which states "Our model improves executability from 59.35 to 67.65 and held-out accuracy from 14.29 to 18.57 over the strongest baseline, a 30% relative accuracy gain."

Evidence:
- "5, our model improves executability from 59.35 to 67.65 and held-out accuracy from 14.29 to 18.57 over the strongest baseline, a 30% relative accuracy" [1]
